story: Click or tap visible ladder artwork -> approach the physical bottom -> follow every switchback -> server confirms stair progress -> ordinary roof transition -> reload and return with the same account, chat and balance.

boundaries.ui: Connected host tests use actual canvas mouse/touch coordinates on the painted middle rung. No direct state mutation or shortcut transition.
boundaries.movement: Shared click movement and server position settle within 3 units at route waypoints. Recorded progress visits all intermediate route waypoints.
boundaries.server: Existing stairStep validator and LobbyRoom transition remain unchanged and are covered by street tests. Full route is required.
boundaries.recovery: Mid-ascent reload retains progress, Up resumes. Roof reconnect and descent retain room, chat and balance.
boundaries.render: Native desktop/mobile frames show the player on the existing wall-mounted stairs, followed by roof arrival. Both facade-corner scenarios also pass on the exact same artifact.
